label: Is bastard
summary: A yes/no value saved in the child birth on_actions: whether the newborn is a known bastard.
details: Vanilla's comment there says it is true if a known bastard. Vanilla tests it with `scope:is_bastard = yes` or `= no`.

label: Is concubine child
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, marks a child as born to a concubine; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Is current obligation
summary: A yes/no value the game gives when the AI picks a tax slot's obligation: whether this obligation is the slot's current one.
details: Vanilla uses it once, in the government script values: when it is yes, the AI's willingness for that obligation goes up by 1.

label: Is eminent site
summary: A yes/no value saved in the religion on_actions: whether the holy site is an eminent one rather than a regular one.
details: Vanilla's comments word it as "is eminent (else it is regular)"; in one on_action it describes the state before the change, in another the state after it. Vanilla uses it 4 times, all in the religion on_actions.

label: Is new holy site
summary: A yes/no value saved in the religion on_actions: whether the holy site was newly created rather than adopted from elsewhere.
details: Vanilla uses it 3 times, all in the religion on_actions.

label: Is puppet action
summary: A yes/no flag that character interactions check, to tell whether the action is carried out as a puppet action.
details: Vanilla uses it 276 times, mostly in character interactions such as the artifact and ce1 interactions, always tested with `?= yes`. What 'puppet' means exactly is not given in the input.

label: Item list
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, is a list of items; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Killer
summary: The character who killed the character who died, when the killer is known.
details: Vanilla's comment in the death on_action says it is set when a killer is known. It is also saved in the bookmark events. Vanilla reads it 151 times, mostly in the death on_actions and the pam triggers.

label: Knights
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, holds a group of knights; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Kurultai members
summary: A list of all characters who were part of the predecessor's kurultai council (the council of a Mongol-style realm).
details: Saved by the mpo on_actions; vanilla uses it twice, both in mpo_on_actions_2.

label: Landed title
summary: A title that an interaction or decision is about, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla uses it 242 times, for example in the diarch interactions and the grant titles interaction. Which title it is depends on the place of use.

label: Landless adventurer
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, refers to a landless adventurer; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Landless noble family
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, refers to a landless noble family; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Leader
summary: In the holy order on_actions, the order's current leader (the holder of its title); elsewhere the leader of whatever the script is about.
details: Vanilla's comments in the holy order on_actions give the holy order meaning. It is used 348 times, also in the Japan interactions, where who counts as leader depends on the place of use.

label: Lease liege
summary: The liege side of a lease contract, saved while the contract's script runs.
details: Vanilla uses it 5 times, all in the theocracy lease contracts, for example in the tax split and for the head of faith being superior. The exact role rests on the name and that use.

label: Lease revoked
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, tells whether a lease was revoked; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Leased out
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, refers to something leased out; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Legend
summary: The legend an action or notification is about.
details: Vanilla's legend types use it for "the legend to promote" and "the legend to take ownership" of. It is used 134 times, for example in the important actions files for ce1 and ep3.

label: Lessee
summary: The character who holds the lease in a lease contract.
details: Vanilla uses it 18 times, in the theocracy lease contracts (where the ruler's opinion of them and their tax share are checked) and the councillor triggers. The role rests on the name and those uses.

label: Liberated baronies
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, holds baronies that were liberated; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Liege
summary: The liege (overlord) of the character the script is about, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla's courtier management comment reads "their liege". It is one of the most used saved names: 1,971 uses, for example in the court position tasks.

label: Main destiny types
summary: A list of flags naming the main destiny character types available to the player; it may be empty.
details: Saved by the on_action that lets the player pick a destiny. Vanilla adds flags such as `flag:interesting_destiny_character` to it.

label: Mass action
summary: A yes/no flag in the prison interactions: whether the action runs as a mass action.
details: Vanilla uses it 6 times, all in the prison interactions. Its comments there speak of the 'mass ransom', where only gold is offered. Scripts check `exists = scope:mass_action` first, since it is not always saved.

label: Matrilineal
summary: A yes/no value that, going by its name, says whether a marriage is matrilineal (children belong to the mother's line).
details: Vanilla uses it 25 times, in the marriage interactions and the marriage scripted modifiers, where `scope:matrilineal = yes` is checked next to the betrothed's own matrilinear setting.

label: Mercenary companies
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, holds mercenary companies; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Migration
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, refers to a migration; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Minimal travel time
summary: A number the game gives when a guest decides whether to accept an activity invitation: the estimated travel time in a straight line, in days.
details: Vanilla uses it 7 times, all in the activity scripted modifiers, where it is compared with limits such as at least 1, above 10 and at most 25.

label: Monthly character expenses
summary: A number the game gives when the AI weighs court positions and court position tasks: the liege's monthly expenses.
details: The game's notes for court position types call it the liege's general purchasing power; those for court position tasks, the current monthly expenses. Vanilla's own script does not read it.

label: Mother
summary: The pregnant mother, in the child birth on_actions; elsewhere the mother of the character the script is about.
details: Vanilla's comments in the child birth on_actions call it the pregnant mother. It is used 465 times, also in the pam on_actions.

label: Mover
summary: The character leaving a court; the game gives it to the guest system's effects.
details: Vanilla's guest system comment says its effects are called with `scope:mover` as a character. It is used 44 times, in the guest system and the courtier guest management effects.

label: My language counties
summary: The counties in the AI ruler's realm whose culture has their own native language.
details: Saved for the culture script values and the scripted rules; vanilla uses it 3 times. In the culture values it is subtracted from another count.

label: Name character target
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, is the character who is being named; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: New acclaimed knight
summary: Going by its name, the knight who has just become acclaimed, saved by the accolade on_actions and effects.
details: Vanilla uses it 6 times, in the accolade on_actions and accolade scripted effects. The input gives no comment explaining it.

label: New accolade type
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, is a new accolade type; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: New confederation
summary: Going by its name, the confederation that has just been created, saved in the mpo interaction events.
details: Vanilla uses it 4 times, all in mpo_interactions_events.txt. The input gives no comment explaining it.

label: New councillor
summary: Going by its name, the character who has just been appointed to the council, saved by the councillor effects.
details: Vanilla uses it 19 times, in the councillor effects and the tgp scripted effects. The input gives no comment explaining it.

label: New culture
summary: The culture that has just been created or switched to, saved while the script that follows runs.
details: Vanilla saves it in a major decision and in the culture on_actions, and uses it 42 times, for example in the culture effects.

label: New diarchy
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, is a newly started diarchy; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: New employer
summary: The ruler who is the character's new employer, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla's comment in the court maintenance on_actions reads "their new employer". It is used 234 times, also in the adventurer AI effects.

label: New faith
summary: The faith a character is converting to, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla's comments in the religion script values and the scripted rules describe it that way. It is used 99 times, also in the bastard effects, where the place of use decides the exact meaning.

label: New holder
summary: The new holder of a title, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla's comment in the title on_actions reads "new holder". It is used 52 times, also in the ep3 decisions.

label: New holy order
summary: Going by its name, the holy order that has just been created, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla uses it 68 times, for example in the holy order decisions and the ep3 Hasan story cycle decisions, where its title is shown as an icon.

label: New inspiration
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, is a newly created inspiration; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: New location
summary: A location saved for the script that follows; going by its name, the place something has moved to.
details: Vanilla uses it 228 times; the example given is the game rule events, where armies in that location are looked up. The kind of place (province, county) is not shown in the input.

label: New memory
summary: The memory just made by `create_character_memory`, which saves it under this name.
details: The effect's own documentation and the game's notes for memory types both say so. Vanilla uses it 113 times, for example in the pilgrimage and university visit activities.

label: New owner
summary: A character who becomes the owner of something, saved for the script that follows.
details: In the debug interactions it is the recipient or, failing that, the acting character, and the target is then given to them with `set_owner`. Vanilla uses it 8 times in all, also in the accolade on_actions.

label: New rite
summary: The rite (a religious practice of a faith) that has just been created, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla's comment on a pam effect says it runs on rite creation and that `scope:new_rite` must exist. The ep3 decision saves the rite of the root. It is used 92 times, also in the religion on_actions.

label: New successor
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, is a newly named successor; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: New title
summary: Going by its name, a title that has just been created, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla uses it 156 times, for example in the casus belli types for religious war and the fp1 wars. A vanilla comment notes a failed split leaves it unset, so check that it exists before using it.

label: New value
summary: A new value after a change; for subject contracts, how much the changes benefit the subject.
details: While a subject contract is being changed, the game gives a number under this name: how much the changes help the subject, from how much the obligations' scores rise. Vanilla's court grandeur on_actions use it for a new level instead. It is used 14 times in all, and its meaning depends on the place.

label: None
summary: A saved name called none; vanilla script never uses it.
details: Not to be confused with the plain word `none`. The game documents nothing more.

label: Number of legends
summary: The number of existing legends the character could support, used in the scripted rules.
details: Vanilla uses it twice, in the scripted rules file, where it is checked against a limit of 5.

label: Number missing
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, is a count of something missing; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Number of relations
summary: The total number of relations to the other houses in the same bloc (confederation).
details: The confederation types info file lists it that way. In the tgp script values a base value is divided by it. Vanilla uses it once in script.

label: Slots with obligation
summary: A number the game gives when the AI picks a tax slot's obligation: how many of the liege's other tax slots have this obligation.
details: Vanilla uses it 3 times: the AI's willingness for an obligation is reduced by it, and the clan tax collector obligation checks whether it is 0.

label: Vassal slots
summary: A number the game gives when the AI picks a tax slot's obligation: the slot's vassal limit.
details: Vanilla uses it twice: the government script values halve it, and the clan tax collector obligation reads it as a value.

label: Obedient kurultai
summary: A list of all obedient characters who were part of the kurultai election, both council and children.
details: Saved by the mpo on_actions; vanilla uses it twice, both in mpo_on_actions_2.

label: Obligation
summary: The vassal contract obligation an interaction is changing, saved for the script that follows.
details: Vanilla uses it 22 times, all in the modify vassal contract interaction, where its contract type and level are read.

label: Occupied baronies
summary: A saved name that, going by its name, holds occupied baronies; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Offensive
summary: A saved name called offensive; vanilla script never uses it.
details: The game documents nothing more.
